title: Watermarking Diffusion Language Models with Learned Foresight and Balanced Bands
abstract: arXiv:2610.32205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Green-red watermarks favor tokens from a green list that a secret key derives from the preceding tokens. Diffusion language models, however, often choose a token before its preceding tokens, and the token later shapes its neighbors' green lists. Prior work therefore tilts each choice to raise the expected number of green tokens at its own and its neighbors' positions. Building on this objective, we first learn two components that prior work keeps fixed: vocabulary bands that serve as green lists, separate competing candidates and keep the null distribution exact, and a foresight predictor that estimates how each candidate shifts its neighbors' predictions. Second, we count green tokens as the detector does, once per distinct context-token pair, so repetition earns nothing. On WaterBench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, each learned component raises the z-score at equal distortion, and their gains are nearly additive. With a strong watermark, ours

translated_title: 基于学习式前瞻与平衡频带的扩散语言模型水印方法
translated_abstract: 绿-红水印机制会偏向选择“绿名单”中的token，而绿名单由密钥根据前序token生成。然而，扩散语言模型在选择某个token时，其前序token往往尚未确定，且该token之后又会影响其相邻位置的绿名单。因此，先前的工作在每次选择时都向提高自身及相邻位置绿token期望数量的方向倾斜。在这一目标的基础上，我们首先学习先前工作中保持固定的两个组件：作为绿名单的词表频带，用于区分相互竞争的候选token并保持零分布的精确性；以及一个前瞻预测器，用于估计每个候选token会如何改变相邻位置的预测分布。其次，我们按照检测器的方式统计绿token，即每个不同的上下文-token对只计一次，因此重复内容不会带来任何收益。在WaterBench上使用LLaDA-8B-Instruct进行的实验表明，每个学习组件都能在同等失真水平下提升z分数，且两者的增益几乎是可叠加的。在采用强水印时，我们的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种面向扩散语言模型的水印方法，通过学习平衡的词表频带和前瞻预测器，并以检测器视角对绿token去重计数，在同等文本失真下显著提升了水印检测强度。
en_tdlr: A watermarking method for diffusion language models that learns balanced vocabulary bands and a foresight predictor, and counts green tokens the way the detector does, achieving higher z-scores at equal distortion.
